title: Bed Among the Lentils
description:
Alan Bennett is a renowned playwright and Oscar nominee. This BAFTA winning play originated from his series of plays 'Talking Heads'. It about The Vicar, his wife and a Grocer.  Rose plays the Vicar’s wife and we see how she was once on the carousel of life, married this good looking, charismatic man, fell off the carousel and tries to climb back on. It is keenly observed, funny and very moving. 

Performances in the studio of the Lexicon Library in DunLaoghaire Friday 26 June and Thursday 2 July at 7.30pm. 55 mins.
